breaking_news.headline: Oil jumps more than 2% as U.S.-Iran diplomacy stalls; equities and long bonds weaken
breaking_news.summary: WTI rose to about $84.66 and Brent to $90.81 as supply-risk concerns intensified. Higher energy prices revived inflation concerns while long-dated Treasury yields climbed.
breaking_news.market_impact: Energy outperformed while most S&P 500 sectors fell; higher oil and long yields are a valuation headwind for long-duration growth stocks.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Watch high-valuation AI/tech names, transport costs and petrochemical/energy-linked names; the SOX divergence suggests semiconductor momentum remained firmer than broad software.

breaking_news.headline: Weak U.S. retail sales and softer inflation reduce near-term Fed hike expectations
breaking_news.summary: Markets scaled back expectations for a near-term Fed move after weak retail sales and softer July CPI/PPI readings, while the dollar weakened.
breaking_news.market_impact: Short-rate expectations eased, but fiscal/debt supply concerns kept long Treasury yields elevated.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A softer dollar can help Asian FX risk appetite, but the benefit is partly offset by rising long yields and oil.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: SOX rises about 1.6% even as broad U.S. indexes decline
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Micron gained about 4% and Applied Materials about 5.5%, while software weakened; the session showed a clear chip-versus-software divergence.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI/semiconductor capital-equipment and memory demand remained relatively resilient despite macro pressure.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive relative read-through for TSMC, advanced packaging, memory, equipment and AI-server supply chains, subject to TSM ADR and Taiwan-futures confirmation.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Alphabet prepares inaugural Australian-dollar bond sale as hyperscalers broaden AI-capex funding
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported Alphabet was preparing an Australian-dollar bond deal, another sign large cloud firms are diversifying funding for heavy computing capex.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Supports the view that AI infrastructure spending remains structurally large, while raising attention to leverage and free-cash-flow discipline.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Longer-run demand support for foundry, AI accelerators, networking, server ODM, PCB and power/cooling supply chains.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA Q2 FY27 results scheduled for Aug. 26
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: NVIDIA Investor Relations confirms fiscal Q2 FY27 results on Aug. 26, 2026 at about 1:20 p.m. PT, followed by a 2 p.m. PT call.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The report is the next major validation point for AI accelerator demand and data-center capex.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Critical for TSMC, CoWoS/advanced packaging, AI-server ODM, networking, PCB, cooling and power names.

narration_points: 8月17日美股四大指數全面收低，但半導體逆勢走強。
市場壓力來自油價與長債殖利率同步上升：WTI約84.66美元、上漲2.74%，美國10年期殖利率約4.724%。
美元指數約99.60、略為走弱；黃金升至約4420美元。
SOX逆勢上漲約1.6%，Micron與Applied Materials表現強勢，顯示晶片股相對軟體股更有韌性。
台股盤前優先觀察台積電、CoWoS、AI伺服器、記憶體、設備與散熱電源鏈，但高油價與高長債殖利率仍是估值壓力。
本週焦點是Home Depot、Target與Walmart零售財報，以及週三FOMC會議紀要；NVIDIA則將在8月26日公布財報。
